findings.note: McNeely is listed among the sponsors of House Bill 1231, No Voter Registration Changes At DMV (primary sponsors are three other members). The bill would stop voters from changing an existing registration (address, name, party) at the DMV website or DMV offices and require those changes at county boards of elections. The bill text keeps the DMV question asking applicants whether they are U.S. citizens. Referred to the House Rules committee on 5/12/2026.
